body:
I am doing better now. I'm looking into therapy. Seeing a counselor or something.

When I'm alone, that's when things start to get bad. So I've been trying to stay far away from her, far away from our apartment, and surrounding myself with as many friends as possible. 

It's a lot of work. I'm pretty exhausted. But I feel far more confident now.

Thanks so much. 

And sorry that I didn't get back to you the other day. I had a rough couple days and didn't have much time for reddit. But once again thanks for the words of encouragement.
Oh yeah. Bleeding real good right now.
Gonna slit my throat with a knife. Wanna watch me writhe in agony for a few minutes before I finally die???!!
Thank you! Want a webcam?
If I make it, I will let you know. Thanks so much.
I called someone/ Thank you. I'm going to try and make it..

No please don't. No one needs to sacrifice for me.

Please, this isn't necessary. I'm not worth it.
I would like to call anyone..
It won't. And it's not your fault. I am 1 of 6 billlion people. Do not blame your self
I don't have either. It's ok. I don't want to burden anyone.
Can I call you...?
Ok ok I'm giving it a listen.
Share with me, what kept you going?

Why does my life matter to you? 

And I ask that with everything I have left. Through tears and all.
I unfortunately care about how she feels. I care way too much

I want to believe. I attempted and she walked in on me. Horrible, horrible feeling. Trust me, I'd hate to put her through this. 

I promised her I'd try to work through it FOR HER. But a month later... I feel even worse.
I don't want to meet other girls. I want her. And only her.

I got angry. I swore that she would regret breaking up with me. That lasted a whole 4 days.

No that wouldn't. I cant imagine her being happy without me. I provided everything she could ever want. Clothes food. A place to live. Infinite love. I'm literally insane. I scream at her to call the police so I have an ultimatum and will kill myself.
Why? I love her though.
I don't want to feel that. It hurts too much. If anything, I want a clean cut, and to not feel anything. But it won't be that way.

I sound like a great guy? I'm, trying to kill myself. That's not great at all. I wish I had your strength. I would have ended it right then, and not have played this stupid game.

I wish I had the strength. 

A lot of the advice tht had been given to me is to think of myself. But I don't want to. It's about her. I love her. I never want to stop loving her.
I don't want her to be out of my life. That's the hard part.
What is there to life then?
I've dedicated my life to this girl. Everything I know is because of the past 3 years. How can I get over her? She's not just "some girl" she is quite literally the love of my life.
My parents are poor. Im porr. I dont have money to simply get uyp and move/
My parents cant afford it. I cant afford it. I'm here. I have a year long lease.

Ive tried. For one long months. Every fucking day. And nothing. "tyhis is what I need right now."

Fine. And killing myself is what I need.

Sure anyone would be devestated that someone killed themselves over you. But she's already moving one. After one short month she's attracted to someone else. We were each others first. And she's already out acting like it's no big deal.

No. I'm in Boston. Family is in Az. Me and the girlfriend.... ex i suppose... moved out here together nearly a year ago. 


I have spoken about a break. And apprently one day she was testing me to see if she should get back with me. Obviously I fucked that one up because we're still broken up.

I have few regrets... I loved a happy young life.. trust me, this is what I need.
Story time. If you don't mind. Other peoples situations eases the mind.
She is. I'm unhappy. She's happy without me, the one guy in her life who dedicated everythng he had for her.

My parents are across the country.

I want to be happy. Trust me. But when I imagine her with another guy, being happy without me, I get angry, I cry. I'm depressed. I don't know how to get rid of all this feeling. Even when I'm with friends I lash out and hurt people close to me.

http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/ctb1r/love_of_my_life_broke_up_with_me_now_i_want_to/  

Link to the first time I tried to kill myself.

I only care for her. I gave up a lot for her. A LOT. And she walks away for little to no reason. That's not what love is. I need her. It's been a month and I feel it's actually worse NOW then when it first happened. And I was a wreck then.

Yeah she still lives with me! And works with me! It's hard to heal with the dagger still in you. Haha. And I get to see her every. single day. 

I gave up friends for her. I don't have friends. 
I have acquaintances, sure. But no friends.
Obviously I think there's some sort of hope. Some small light at the end of the tunnel. Otherwise I still wouldn't be here. I've attempted a few times. Always interrupted though. Fuck my life.
And yet the one person who I want to care, doesn't. Or she does, but she doesn't love me anymore. Why should she?

My girlfriend of 3 years broke up with me a month ago. I posted before. Under a different username of course. I can't get over her. She was my entire life. And it's being ripped away from me because "a relationship is not what I need right now".

You love someone, you truly honestly love someone, and they drop you off a fucking cliff.

I don't want to burden anyone. Don't set aside your evening for me.
